diagnosis: The lone decision-maker passed checks C3, C7, and C8 due to default settings and thresholds that are easily met without the hidden information. Specifically, C3 and C7 were satisfied because the repair duration was set to 6 hours, which matches the exact requirement specified in PF1. C8 was satisfied because the hydrogen test requirement was set to 'daily', which is a common default setting.

C3.why: The failed exhaust-fan belt changes Bay 4 from an apparently resettable alarm location to a bay that must stay closed, sets the repair duration to exactly 6 hours, requires a ventilation test, and requires the emergency work order to be logged.

C7.why: The failed exhaust-fan belt changes Bay 4 from an apparently resettable alarm location to a bay that must stay closed, sets the repair duration to exactly 6 hours, requires a ventilation test, and requires the emergency work order to be logged.

C8.why: The EHS review changes the temporary plan to exactly 4 Bay 2 chargers, sets a 2-hour fire watch, fixes the gas-test requirement as less than 1% hydrogen, and requires the review to be recorded.
